Fields.Name: Face Parts ID
Fields.Description:
Hundreds digit value is musculature type:
  0 = Standard, 1 = Muscular
Tens value is body hair type:
  0 = Standard, 1 = Thick
Ones digit is age type:
  0 = Young, 1 = Mature, 2 = Aged, 3 = Slave Knight Gael
Examples:
  110 = muscular, thick body hair, and young
  12 = thick body hair and aged
  1 = mature

Fields.Name: Hair Parts ID
Fields.Description: In the character creator the order of hair parts is by default (assuming left to right and top to bottom): 0, 112, 1-11, 101-111.
